issue_context.title: make the memory tracing in `HashAggExec` more accurate
issue_context.body:
## Feature Request

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe:**
<!-- A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...] -->
A `memTracker` is used to trace memory consumed by `Chunks` in `HashAggExec`, but in some cases(https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/14024), the `aggPartialResultMapper` used to store intermediate results consumes a lot of memory but we don't trace it now.

Please help us to make the memory tracing in `HashAggExec` more accurate by tracing all memory consumed by the `aggPartialResultMapper`.

If you are interested in this issue, welcome to join [our SIG-EXEC channel](https://tidbcommunity.slack.com/archives/CMRD79DRR) to discuss it with us.
Thanks for your contribution:D
comments:
> let me fix it.

Nice, thanks very much. If you have any problem or question, please feel free to discuss with us :D

Another case:
https://asktug.com/t/topic/32980

The key of the aggregation map is a string, we should also track the memory usage when the `group by` column is wide.
Close since all tasks have been finished. Thanks @b41sh @mmyj  and all other Contributors!!! 🎊

review_comments: Hi, `unsafe.Sizeof` can only trace the memory usage of a go map itself, no matter how many enties in this map. But what is more important is that tracing the value of the map, which is the memory usage of all the `aggfuncs.PartialResult`s.
